hooks.command: $s=git status --porcelain 2>&1;if(-not $s){exit 0};$sf=($s -join ' ');$hs=($sf -match '(?i)\.(env|pem|key|p12|pfx)|id_rsa') -and ($sf -notmatch '\.example');if($hs){Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ 민감 파일 감지 - 자동 커밋 차단됨. /commitandpush 로 수동 처리하세요."}';exit 2};git add .;$n=(git diff --staged --name-only 2>&1|Measure-Object -Line).Lines;if($n -eq 0){exit 0};$fs=((git diff --staged --name-only 2>&1|Select-Object     -First 2)-join', ');git commit -m ('자동: '+$fs+' 외 '+$n+'개 수정'+[char]10+[char]10+'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>') 2>&1;if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){$r=git remote 2>&1;if($r){git push 2>&1}}
